vocabulary.meaning: the complete disappearance of a species
examples: Habitat loss can push animals towards extinction.
The species is officially classified as endangered.

vocabulary.meaning: the variety of living species in an area or on Earth
examples: Biodiversity is declining in many regions.

vocabulary.meaning: the destruction or reduction of the natural places where species live
examples: Habitat loss is one of the biggest threats to wildlife.

vocabulary.meaning: the protection and careful management of nature
examples: Conservation programmes have helped some species recover.
International cooperation is important for conservation.

vocabulary.meaning: a group of living organisms that can reproduce with one another
examples: Scientists discover new species every year.
Some species adapt better to environmental change than others.
